game_title: Strip And Replace – Glacier Lake Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake, a lake of glacier melt: the summit pilot must handle frost wyrms while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Strip And Replace: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it.
theme: Frost Peaks – Glacier Lake: a lake of glacier melt
core_gameplay_loop: In Glacier Lake, repeat each round: Clean messy text with strip() and replace() before the scribes read it. Each round, frost wyrms strike the basecamp tent, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_text value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the basecamp tent from frost wyrms in Glacier Lake: keep the clean_text meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: clean_text drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Strip And Replace
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Strip And Replace' (Week 8 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glacier Lake'. region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_text changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost wyrms in Glacier Lake.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while clean_text > 0.
